summary:
Validate re-run at HEAD 91c955d. No src has changed since eafb1c3; the working tree differs only in .taad files. Everything I could reach passes. The build has 0 warnings. The default suite passes 155/155, and the 35 StoppingWait and SmbRig tests pass. Of the default window cases, all 15 pass through the published exe; in C-006 the scan returned 13 ms after Cancel and no wait line appeared. HookCases H-001 and H-002 pass: close with no Cancel, window gone in 22 ms and process in 79 ms; after a fast cancel the close is refused; the missing marker is refused after 60.2 s. Fitness holds all 25 rules, and the rules harness gives 40/40 AS-RECORDED, including S01-S04 (abandon plants fire; running.WaitAsync stays quiet). I also ran SynchronousIoCancelTests 10 times with 0 failures.

The person's N-001..N-004 pass at eafb1c3 is still valid under the staleness rule. `git diff --name-only eafb1c3 HEAD` over the path list shows only SmbRig.cs, whose blob is the exempt 8fdf6e87. But the pass's own record (its HEAD, per-case results, N-001's Cancel-to-return) is nowhere in the tree or git history. Only reflect-1.json says a person ran it at "validate #4", so I could not read what it measured.

What this stage cannot reach, and why it keeps coming back:
- **O-018 and O-019, the reason for this attempt.** Both need timed real disconnects: Wi-Fi off, tailscale down, sleep and resume. The machine rules forbid those, and the real-disconnect spike ran 0 of 9. I recorded them as cannot-tell. They are aimed at validate-slice, but only a person, or SC-033, can settle them. Validate has now been sent back on these same two obligations three times with no src change. That is a loop. Sending them to validate again will produce this same answer.
- **StalledShareTests (Network=SMB-LOOPBACK) has never run on the extracted rig, by anyone.** O-038, which re-routes O-030 to the person's sitting, is still open against build-slice.
- **C2, the decision this slice exists for, has conflicting records.** The merge rejection that sent design back reads "I choose option (a)". The index labels design attempt 2 "put back: The owner did not choose (a)", with no author. The tree implements (b), and no record shows the person accepting (b). I cannot resolve this, and I did not pick one.

Observed, not graded: four more N-002 runs of the no-Cancel shape were interrupted, at 10:36, 10:40, 11:02 and 11:07 UTC. Each left its hook log and case folder in %TEMP%. This worktree's StallRig.exe was rebuilt at 10:35:35 and last accessed at 11:08:44, so they were very likely run from this worktree. None was mine. The hook logs show the window closed 62-71 ms after Close with the scan stalled and still running. The logs stop there, and no process-exit time was recorded. All eight app PIDs are gone now, and the SMB mappings show only Z:.

checks.what: Faulted ending, and the 90 s no-estimate wording rendered in the real window
checks.evidence: The shipped exe has no seam to fault a scan, and the design forbids adding one. The rig's client gives up at about 60 s, so the 90 s wording cannot be reached in the window. Only the unit tests pin it.

criteria.criterion: 1. Show the wait line after Cancel: under the 2 s gate, including a negative elapsed
criteria.how: StoppingWaitTests.UnderTheGateNothingIsShown (MinValue, -5 s, -1 ms, 0, 1.999 s, 2 s-1 tick) and TheWordingAtEachBoundary rows for -5000/-1/0/1999 ms all return null; 35/35 passed. C-006 in the real exe showed no wait line on a 13 ms cancel.

criteria.criterion: 2. Show the wait line after Cancel: at exactly 2 s and between 2 s and 90 s
criteria.how: StoppingWaitTests.FromTwoSecondsTheLineCountsUpInWholeSeconds and the 2000 and 89999 ms boundary rows passed. The line counts up in floored whole seconds with the 'minute or more' wording. Unit level only: the line appearing in the real window on a real stall is N-001, which I did not run.

criteria.criterion: 3. Show the wait line after Cancel: at 90 s, or an hour
criteria.how: FromNinetySecondsThereIsNoEstimate and the 90000 and 3600000 ms rows passed: no estimate, no overflow up to TimeSpan.MaxValue. Unit level only; the window cannot reach 90 s on the rig.

criteria.criterion: 4. Clear the wait line when the scan returns: Cancel on a stalled share, return on the SMB client timeout (N-001)
criteria.how: Not run: person-run by contract, and it changes SMB mappings. The person's pass at eafb1c3 is not stale by the path rule (only the exempt SmbRig.cs blob changed). But that pass record, including N-001's Cancel-to-return, exists only as reflect-1.json's statement, so I could not read what it measured. By reading: EndStopping sits in the single finally (MainWindow.xaml.cs:167-170).

criteria.criterion: 5. Clear the wait line when the scan returns: an ordinary local cancel (C-006)
criteria.how: WindowCases.ps1 -Case All passed C-006 through the published exe: returned 13 ms after Cancel, detail '-' on every stopping line, and a final line at shutdown.

criteria.criterion: 6. Clear the wait line when the scan returns: the scan faults, or finishes on its own, while the line shows
criteria.how: The design defers both endings (SL-020-scanner.md:192-195), and no test feeds them. By reading only, both pass through the same finally that calls EndStopping. Validate attempt 1's scratch probe at eafb1c3 saw the finished-on-its-own ending clear the line. I did not re-run it, and the faulted ending was never exercised.

criteria.criterion: 7. Close the window while a scan is blocked: Cancel first, scan thread blocked in SMB (N-002)
criteria.how: Not run by me (person-run, SMB mappings). The person's pass at eafb1c3 is attested only in reflect-1.json. Unattributed interrupted runs of N-002's no-Cancel shape from this worktree show the window closed 62-71 ms after Close with the scan stalled. No process-exit time was recorded, and the Cancel-first shape is absent from them.

criteria.criterion: 8. Close the window while a scan is blocked: no Cancel pressed, or the scan already ended locally
criteria.how: HookCases.ps1 H-001 passed on a local tree. With no Cancel and scanning=True, the window was gone 22 ms and the process 79 ms after Close. After a local cancel returned in 10 ms, the armed close was refused with 'the scan was no longer running' and the window stayed open.

criteria.criterion: 9. Close the window after a real disconnect (Wi-Fi off, tunnel down, sleep and resume)
criteria.how: Forbidden on this machine: it changes network state. The spike ran 0 of 9. This is O-018's unproven precondition.

criteria.criterion: 10. Sweep leftover rig mappings, keeping the person's Z: and other non-rig shapes
criteria.how: SmbRigTests.OnlyTheRigsOwnMappingsAreSwept passes all 16 shapes against LoopbackShare.IsRigMapping, the predicate the sweep filters by (SmbRig.cs:85, :115). Read-only: Z: \\100.109.48.75\collab is still mapped after eight rig runs today. A real leftover being swept (N-004) was not run by me.

criteria.criterion: 11. Serialise rig runs: a second run while the first holds RigLock, or a killed run's leftover (N-003, N-004)
criteria.how: The lock level passes: ASecondRunWaitsForTheFirst and ALiveHolderFailsTheNextRunLoudlyAndAKilledOneDoesNotBlockIt. The mapping level (N-003, N-004 with real mappings) is person-run. Its eafb1c3 pass is attested only in reflect-1.json.

criteria.criterion: 12. Run the stalled-share baseline on the extracted rig (StalledShareTests, Network=SMB-LOOPBACK)
criteria.how: No record shows it ever ran after the rig moved to Rig/SmbRig.cs: not build, code-review, validate or the person's eafb1c3 pass (reflect-1.json:112; SL-020-scanner.md:220-221). It compiles, since the build passed. O-038, which asks to re-route O-030 to the person's sitting, is still open against build-slice.

criteria.criterion: 13. Forbid abandoning the scan wait (WaitAsync or Task.WhenAny on the scan task; running.WaitAsync allowed)
criteria.how: The rules harness against the real engine Fitness gave 40/40 AS-RECORDED: S01 _scanTask.WaitAsync, S02 Task.WhenAny and S03 Task.Run(...).WaitAsync fire; S04 running.WaitAsync stays quiet. Fitness op=check holds 25 rules on the tree.

criteria.criterion: 14. Start the window hook in armed mode: marker never appears, stop with no delay, armed throw
criteria.how: HookCases.ps1 H-002 passed. Missing marker: refused after 60.2 s with 'did not appear within 60 s'. Stop with no delay: 'armed stop needs FSA_HOOK_CANCEL_DELAY_MS'. Armed throw: 'throw mode is not armed'. None pressed, closed or threw, and the app kept running.

obligations.evidence: On the loopback rig, closing is an escape that does not wait. Spike 4: window 29 ms or less, process 345 ms or less, 6/6. Today's unattributed interrupted N-002 runs show the window closed 62-71 ms after Close with the scan stalled, but no process-exit time. After a real Wi-Fi, tunnel or sleep disconnect it is unmeasured, and this stage may not cause one. Only a person running the protocol in SL-020-scanner.md:171-176 (or SC-033) can settle it. Routing it to validate again will return this answer.

Only the rig has shown the wait ending on its own: 57-66 s in spike 1, 59.9 s and 62-66 s in C1. The real-disconnect spike ran 0 of 9. The wording gives no end time and drops the estimate at 90 s (unit-tested here), so the UI stays truthful if the precondition fails. The precondition itself needs real disconnects a person must perform.

Owed to build-slice, not to this stage, and still open: the ledger still lists O-030 as DISCHARGED although StalledShareTests has never run on the extracted rig. Recorded here because criterion 12 depends on it.

not_reached: N-001 on the stalled rig at 91c955d, or the content of the person's eafb1c3 pass: wait line at 1.9-3 s, count-up, UI gap no more than 1 s, clear at return, and the measured Cancel-to-return. The pass is attested only by reflect-1.json, and its record (validate-slice-4.json) exists in no tree or ref.
N-002: whether the process ends within 5 s of Close while the scan thread is blocked in SMB, with and without a prior Cancel. Today's interrupted runs show only the window half.
N-003 and N-004 with real mappings on 127.0.0.1 (RigLock serialising two rig runs, and the sweep removing a killed run's leftover).
StalledShareTests (Network=SMB-LOOPBACK) on the extracted rig. Nobody has ever run it; it is person-run, about 70 s.
O-018/O-019: timed real disconnects (Wi-Fi off, tailscale down, sleep about 2 min), 3 runs per mode plus one timed Close per mode. Forbidden to any stage on this machine.

C2, the person's own choice between (a) and (b). The merge rejection says 'I choose option (a)', the index labels design 2 'put back: The owner did not choose (a)' with no author, and the tree implements (b). Only the person can say which record stands.
The 90 s no-estimate wording rendered in the real window (unreachable on the rig, whose client gives up at about 60 s).
A scan that faults while the wait line shows (no seam in the shipped exe; deferred by design).

Who is launching N-002 from this worktree and leaving it interrupted: 8 runs so far, 4 of them today at 10:36-11:07 UTC after StallRig.exe was rebuilt at 10:35:35. Also whether those runs orphan app processes for the full SMB timeout, since no exit time was logged.
